notes: Two branches («ح»): each names شعبة, then the names after him (الحكم، إبراهيم، عبد الرحمن) are written once and belong to both: the shared tail.
The last link is Abdullah: the saying is his act and his words («قال هذا مقام الذي أنزلت عليه سورة البقرة»), so he is read as the speaker, not a scene actor (rule 6).
